subject: Protocol of 2010 to the International Convention on Liability and Compensation for Damage in Connection with the Carriage of Hazardous and Noxious Substances by Sea, 1996 (2010 HNS Protocol / 2010 HNS Convention)
label: SCHEDULED — NOT YET IN FORCE

status_detail.entry_into_force_rule: Article 21: eighteen months after at least twelve States (including four with not less than 2 million GT each) have consented to be bound and contributing cargo of at least 40 million tonnes has been reported

authority: IMO Status of Treaties, 2026 Vol. II, as at 30 September 2026, HNS PROT 2010 (pp. 338-340)

next_decision_or_trigger: Entry into force on 29 November 2027: on that date the label changes to IN FORCE and every consumer must stop describing the Protocol as not yet in force.
